overall_summary: The channel shows very low overall view counts across all initial test videos (ranging between 5 to 20 views). Because the sample size is extremely small and engagement is virtually non-existent, confidence is currently low. The strategy requires a controlled exploration phase focusing on phone/digital memorabilia hooks which slightly outperformed generic ones.

winning_patterns.pattern: Digital memory hooks (phone contacts / saved names)
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos referencing phone numbers and saved names (e.g., A_eLARoegnw with 20 views and a9-G1X5jEOU with 15 views) performed slightly better than abstract or environmental hooks.
winning_patterns.action: Incorporate tangible smartphone habits and chat interaction relics into future hooks.

weak_patterns.evidence: Tea-based or generalized midnight thoughts (e.g., uIbMpCjVutQ with 5 views) yielded lower initial reach.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid slow setup lines; start directly with sharp, relatable modern behavioral triggers.
